Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-1 at 1957 S Kedzie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 in the
area bound by:

      South Kedzie Avenue; a line 48.74 feet north of and parallel tc West 21*' Street; the alley
      next east of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; and West 21*' Street,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Jlchael Scott Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 24*" Ward




Common Address:
1957 S. Kedzie Avenue
